newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound falls against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound falls against dollar.

text.p: The Egyptian pound fell against the dollar in the private-sector market on Tuesday as demand for the U.S. currency continued, bankers said.
"The market is short of dollars because some public-sector banks are coming up to the end of their fiscal year," said one banker. The year ends on June 30.
Private-sector bankers said the dollar ranged from 3.3950 pounds to 3.3975 pounds bid and from 3.3960 pounds to 3.3990 offered in the interbank market.
A survey of five actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3960 pounds bid and 3.3979 offered. The averages compare to 3.3950 pounds bid and 3.3974 pounds offered on Monday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.390793 buy and 3.398806 sell.
